newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha dips with crude, buyers hold back.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha dips with crude, buyers hold back.

text.p: NWE naphtha dipped with easier crude on Monday in very slow business.

Dealers said full range cargoes were off $1-2 a tonne around $232 cif NWE. Buyers were said to be looking relaxed as the energy complex slipped lower. Petchem buyers were understood to be trying to push their requirement for material into February.
Prices had been broadly steady, albeit with a softer tone, for much of the day, but renewed losses on crude and U.S gasoline futures turned the tables late in the day.
Interest from the U.S was still evident, but freight rates were becoming to high.
The physical difficulty of obtaining a vessel mounted.
Light virgin material was thought thinly offered, but attracting an early afternoon bid of quotes +$4 cif Antwerp.
